summary: City page + Jan 2026 fee schedule confirm $20 electric / $25 full-hookup (dated), 30/50 A, water, sewer, FCFS (move zones every 14 days), daily vehicle permit on top. No site count anywhere. Not waterfront kept (pads not identifiable per site); pin is the lake office, not a camping area.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (no upgrade earned). The city publishes no campground map and no per-site list, so the hookup pads (zones 25, 26 and 3E) can't be told from primitive camping. Imagery shows campers in open grassland at three places: the south-shore peninsula around 37.3468,-96.8893 (an east row ~30-50 m from the water behind a fringe of shoreline trees/brush, a west group ~60-80 m back); the boat-ramp point around 37.3466,-96.8927 (parking/day use, a couple of campers ~50 m back); and the north shore around 37.3595,-96.8887 (campers ~20-30 m from a tree-lined bank). The lake is large (well over 1,000 acres) and open grassland surrounds it, so LAKEVIEW would be supportable for most of these if AWH wants it, but not without knowing which spots are the pads; lakefront is not earned (tree/brush band, pads unidentified).

PIN (weak): stored 37.34165,-96.89763 is the Winfield City Lake Office / kiosk at the south entrance (Google 37.34140,-96.89749), ~700 m+ from the nearest campers. The south-shore camper area at ~37.3468,-96.8893 is the closest candidate, but which zone it is (and whether it has hookups) is unconfirmed.

SPLIT (weak): the city says pads are on 'both sides of the lake'. The south-shore campers (~37.3468,-96.8893) and the north-shore campers (~37.3595,-96.8887) are ~1.4 km apart across open water, and imagery shows separate road access (south fingers from the south roads; north shore from the road along the north side). Separate places by the ~1 km + own-entrance test, but with no city map I can't say which side has which hookups.

FEES: stored 20-25 is confirmed and dated (fee schedule 'Updated January 2026', City Lake fees by Bill No. 2575, 12/15/2025). The city also requires a vehicle recreation permit, $10 a calendar day ($45 annual), 'in addition to camping fees'; the schedule's 'with license' wording is ambiguous on whether the camper's own vehicle is covered, so it is in fees.note rather than entrance.
SITES: no count published anywhere (city page, fee schedule); left unknown. Facilities (showers, dump) not stated on the city page; stored derived values left as they are.
PHONE 620-221-5635 confirmed (city page 'Lake Office'). Website confirmed.
